messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout 'wave-2026-03-20' -> target traffic: 10% for 15m then 30% for 15m. Model: rwd-llama-2v2-13b-q4 @stable:v2.4.3. Change window: 2026-03-20 09:00-09:30 PT. Canary: canary-42. Monitor: https://grafana.redwood/wave-42 :rocket:
sara: seeing a small tail-latency bump on eu-west at +12m into the 10% window, p95 went from 180ms -> 420ms. Not huge but user-facing. Posting quick flamegraph and logs.
---
flamegraph: cpu spike on kv-cache flush in runtime::kv_cache.cpp: line ~312
error snippet: 
[WARN] kvcache flush took 320ms for shard-3
---

deploy-bot: Alert: latency_anomaly detected for canary-42 (eu-west). p95 spike above threshold. Automated rollback allowed: false (policy = observe). :warning:
tony: can we hold the rollout? recommend pause at current fraction (10%) and pin traffic back to v2.4.2 for eu-west while we investigate. 
maria: agree hold. also suggest enabling fallback to rwd-llama-2v2-7b for tail requests during investigation (cheap fallback). That would reduce user impact while maintaining throughput.
kevin: +1 for hold. can we confirm whether this is KV cache eviction related? sara, any TTL or shard rebalancer activity around that time?
sara: rebalancer ran a routine compaction 2m before spike on shard-3. compaction sometimes triggers synchronous flushes. I'll correlate.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 10% by manual request from tony. canary-42 -> status PAUSED.
tony: execution plan: 1) Pin eu-west nodes to v2.4.2 (rollforward disabled) 2) Enable fallback routing for 20% of requests to 7b 3) Re-run 10m smoke with kv flush instrumented. If stable, resume to 30%. Anyone object?
maria: no objections. I'll open a quick PR to flip the fallback flag and update runbook docs.
kevin: if we pin, can you paste the command you'll run so I can audit?
tony: running now: ```bash
deployctl rollout pause --id=canary-42 --reason="latency spike eu-west"
deployctl traffic pin --region=eu-west --model=rwd-llama-2v2-13b --version=v2.4.2
deployctl routing set-fallback --id=canary-42 --fallback-model=rwd-llama-2v2-7b --fallback-weight=20
```
sara: after pinning, I'll enable extra kv-cache logging and kick a synthetic traffic run. will post results in ~6m.
deploy-bot: Action log: pause requested by tony at 2495012401. pin job started.
kevin: thanks. once sara posts the smoke results we can decide resume vs rollback. please also capture a heap profile if heavy.~
